schema: PHY-14 ENV limit profiles and rule data, draft 0.1 (TECHNICAL_SPEC §3.2). AF-30.

ASTM_E595.conditions: 125 degC, 24 h, < 7e-3 Pa (5e-5 torr); condensables collected at 25 degC; outputs TML, CVCM, optional WVR

ECSS_Q_ST_70_02C.conditions: 24 h preconditioning at 22 degC / 55 % RH, then 125 degC, 24 h, high vacuum; outputs TML, RML, CVCM (and WVR)

profiles.label: NASA GSFC outgassing screening (database background, ASTM E595)
profiles.source: S3 (outgassing.nasa.gov background: maximum TML 1.0 %, maximum CVCM 0.10 %) + S4 (data.nasa.gov listing)
profiles.note: GSFC preferred practice PD-1410 (S7) words it as TML < 1.0 % and CVCM < 0.10 %; the operator differs between sources (OQ-ENV-01). Programs may tailor.

profiles.label: ECSS-Q-ST-70-02C general acceptance
profiles.source: S6 (test-lab report quoting ECSS-Q-ST-70-02C: RML < 1,00 %, CVCM < 0,10 %)
profiles.note: the standard notes acceptance depends on application and location and can be more severe

derived.RML: RML = TML - WVR (recovered mass loss: mass loss without the regained water); S6, S8

kaptonH.source: S9 (JAXA repository paper: first measured on STS-8/EOIM-1) + S10 (SPENVIS/ECSS erosion background); used as the fluence reference in flight experiments
kaptonH.caveat: S9/S11: Ey depends on exposure conditions; ground-facility values differ

moisture.model: Fickian 1D diffusion through a plate of thickness h exposed on both faces (Crank plane sheet; Shen & Springer 1976 for composites)
moisture.source: S14 (Shen & Springer, J. Compos. Mater. 10 (1976) 2-20) + S15 (Crank, The Mathematics of Diffusion, catalogue)
moisture.materialData: D(T), Mm(RH) and beta are material data: none sourced in this session (tbd); synthetic values in the generator only
